@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'FrontmatterDocumentStack: the `enabled` frontmatter key and the view of the enabled documents'
+---
+Request from the FoundationModelsACPAgent session, for the owner. Skills (SkillsRegistry.swift:779), Agents (AgentCatalogBuilder.swift:268) and the planned Rules (plan.md:401) read their documents through FrontmatterDocumentStack. One `enabled: true|false` key here covers all three.
+
+## Rules
+- The key is `enabled`, a YAML bool. When the key is missing, the document is enabled.
+- A value that is not a bool gives one diagnostic through onDiagnostic, and the document stays enabled.
+- The stack reads the key from the raw frontmatter, apart from the decode of the consumer, so that each `Metadata` type gets it.
+- A frontmatter that is not YAML or not a mapping: the document is enabled, with no second diagnostic (the decode diagnostic of the consumer stays as it is).
+- The check runs after the layer shadowing. The nearest copy of a name wins. When that copy says `enabled: false`, the item is off, and a lower copy does not come back.
+- A disabled document whose decode fails (for example a stub that holds only `enabled: false`) gives no decode diagnostic.
+- No lock policy in Extras: a consumer decides for itself whether a built-in item can be off.
+
+## API (additive only: Router, Agents and Skills build against main)
+- `FrontmatterDocument.isEnabled: Bool`. `init(metadata:content:isEnabled: Bool = true)`, so each current call of `init(metadata:content:)` still compiles.
+- `FrontmatterDocumentStack.enabledItems(in:named:)` and `enabledTree(_:)` give only the enabled documents. `item(at:)`, `items` and `tree` still give each document, with its `isEnabled`, so that a UI can list the disabled items.
+- `FrontmatterDocument.enabledKey == "enabled"`.
+
+## Tests (write them first, see them fail)
+`Tests/FoundationModelsExtrasTests/FrontmatterEnabledTests.swift`
+- [ ] a missing key, `enabled: true` and no frontmatter each give isEnabled true
+- [ ] `enabled: false` gives false, with a raw-String decode and with the YAMLValue decode
+- [ ] a value that is not a bool (`"false"`, `0`, a list) gives one diagnostic and isEnabled true
+- [ ] a project stub with only `enabled: false` hides the defaults copy in enabledItems and enabledTree; items still gives the stub, with isEnabled false
+- [ ] the stub gives no decode diagnostic with a decode that fails on it
+- [ ] malformed YAML: enabled, and only the decode diagnostic
+- [ ] `FrontmatterDocument(metadata:content:)` gives isEnabled true #frontmatter-enabled
\ No newline at end of file
